nix.description: Off by default in Renovate; reads the flake inputs in flake.nix

pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate; bumps the hook `rev:` pins in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

lockFileMaintenance.description: `nix flake update` for flake.lock — the nix manager only moves inputs whose ref changed, so without this the pinned revisions never refresh.

customManagers.description: Track version pins in the Nix let bindings annotated with `# renovate: ...` comments

description: @playwright/mcp runs in --extension mode: the Playwright MCP Bridge Chrome extension auto-updates and cannot be pinned, so a server lagging behind it is rejected with 'unsupported protocol version' and the browser bridge simply stops working.

minimumReleaseAge is waived here because a 3-day hold is a guaranteed 3-day outage window, while the risk it buys down is a hypothetical malicious publish from the Playwright team. automerge is the operative half: an exempted PR that still waits on a human reproduces exactly the lag the exemption removes. CI (lint/test/gitleaks) still gates the merge.
This is the ONLY package with either waiver. Everything else keeps the repo-wide 3-day hold.
